<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 640 360" font-family="'Courier New',monospace">
  <defs>
    <radialGradient id="qh-vig" cx="50%" cy="50%" r="72%">
      <stop offset="55%" stop-color="#000000" stop-opacity="0"/>
      <stop offset="100%" stop-color="#000000" stop-opacity="0.85"/>
    </radialGradient>
    <linearGradient id="qh-scan" x1="0" y1="0" x2="0" y2="1">
      <stop offset="0%" stop-color="#e8dcc0" stop-opacity="0"/>
      <stop offset="50%" stop-color="#e8dcc0" stop-opacity="0.9"/>
      <stop offset="100%" stop-color="#e8dcc0" stop-opacity="0"/>
    </linearGradient>
    <pattern id="qh-castH" width="64" height="20" patternUnits="userSpaceOnUse">
      <rect x="0" y="0" width="32" height="20" fill="#b8ad8a"/>
    </pattern>
    <pattern id="qh-castV" width="20" height="64" patternUnits="userSpaceOnUse">
      <rect x="0" y="0" width="20" height="32" fill="#b8ad8a"/>
    </pattern>
    <pattern id="qh-grid" width="40" height="40" patternUnits="userSpaceOnUse">
      <path d="M40 0V40M0 40H40" stroke="#3a3428" stroke-width="0.5"/>
    </pattern>
    <pattern id="qh-grateA" width="5" height="10" patternUnits="userSpaceOnUse">
      <rect x="0" y="0" width="1.4" height="10" fill="#8f866a"/>
    </pattern>
    <pattern id="qh-grateB" width="9" height="10" patternUnits="userSpaceOnUse">
      <rect x="0" y="0" width="2.4" height="10" fill="#8f866a"/>
    </pattern>
    <style>
      .qh-flick{animation:qhfl 3.3s steps(1,end) infinite}
      @keyframes qhfl{0%,94%{opacity:1}96%{opacity:.86}98%{opacity:.97}100%{opacity:1}}
      .qh-title{fill:#e8dcc0;font-weight:700;letter-spacing:7px}
      .qh-sub{fill:#8f866a;letter-spacing:2px}
      .qh-lbl{fill:#c9c2ad;letter-spacing:2px}
      .qh-cnt{fill:#e8dcc0;font-weight:700;letter-spacing:1px}
    </style>
  </defs>

  <!-- CRT ground -->
  <rect x="0" y="0" width="640" height="360" fill="#070707"/>
  <rect x="18" y="18" width="604" height="324" fill="url(#qh-grid)"/>

  <g class="qh-flick">
    <!-- convergence crosshair -->
    <line x1="20" y1="180" x2="620" y2="180" stroke="#6f6850" stroke-width="1"/>
    <line x1="320" y1="20" x2="320" y2="340" stroke="#6f6850" stroke-width="1"/>

    <!-- geometry circles -->
    <circle cx="320" cy="180" r="150" fill="none" stroke="#d8c79a" stroke-width="2"/>
    <circle cx="320" cy="180" r="112" fill="none" stroke="#5a5340" stroke-width="0.8"/>
    <circle cx="320" cy="180" r="70"  fill="none" stroke="#5a5340" stroke-width="0.8"/>

    <!-- resolution gratings, three corners -->
    <rect x="52"  y="52"  width="56" height="40" fill="url(#qh-grateB)" opacity="0.8"/>
    <rect x="532" y="52"  width="56" height="40" fill="url(#qh-grateA)" opacity="0.8"/>
    <rect x="52"  y="268" width="56" height="40" fill="url(#qh-grateA)" opacity="0.8"/>

    <!-- muted colour bars (classic, dimmed for the overnight service) -->
    <g>
      <rect x="200" y="100" width="35" height="22" fill="#c9c2ad"/>
      <rect x="235" y="100" width="34" height="22" fill="#b3a85c"/>
      <rect x="269" y="100" width="34" height="22" fill="#5aa39c"/>
      <rect x="303" y="100" width="34" height="22" fill="#5a9a63"/>
      <rect x="337" y="100" width="34" height="22" fill="#a35a90"/>
      <rect x="371" y="100" width="34" height="22" fill="#a35a5a"/>
      <rect x="405" y="100" width="35" height="22" fill="#5a63a3"/>
      <rect x="200" y="100" width="240" height="22" fill="none" stroke="#3a3428" stroke-width="0.6"/>
    </g>

    <!-- grayscale step wedge -->
    <g>
      <rect x="200" y="236" width="24" height="22" fill="#0a0a0a"/>
      <rect x="224" y="236" width="24" height="22" fill="#242219"/>
      <rect x="248" y="236" width="24" height="22" fill="#3a372a"/>
      <rect x="272" y="236" width="24" height="22" fill="#514d3b"/>
      <rect x="296" y="236" width="24" height="22" fill="#69644d"/>
      <rect x="320" y="236" width="24" height="22" fill="#827c60"/>
      <rect x="344" y="236" width="24" height="22" fill="#9c9575"/>
      <rect x="368" y="236" width="24" height="22" fill="#b6ae8b"/>
      <rect x="392" y="236" width="24" height="22" fill="#c8c09b"/>
      <rect x="416" y="236" width="24" height="22" fill="#d8cfa9"/>
      <rect x="200" y="236" width="240" height="22" fill="none" stroke="#3a3428" stroke-width="0.6"/>
    </g>

    <!-- callsign box -->
    <rect x="248" y="40" width="144" height="26" fill="#0d0d0b" stroke="#8f866a" stroke-width="1"/>
    <text x="320" y="58" text-anchor="middle" font-size="13" class="qh-lbl">K S A B  ·  C H  7</text>

    <!-- hero title -->
    <text x="320" y="152" text-anchor="middle" font-size="21" class="qh-title">THE QUIET HOUR</text>

    <!-- creep line -->
    <text x="320" y="212" text-anchor="middle" font-size="11" class="qh-sub" font-style="italic">please remain seated</text>

    <!-- the clock -->
    <text x="320" y="304" text-anchor="middle" font-size="15" class="qh-lbl">● 02:00 ●</text>

    <!-- lower-right counter (increments by one, then by three, then settles) -->
    <rect x="470" y="288" width="130" height="34" fill="#0d0d0b" stroke="#8f866a" stroke-width="1"/>
    <text x="535" y="301" text-anchor="middle" font-size="8" class="qh-sub">STILL AWAKE</text>
    <text x="535" y="317" text-anchor="middle" font-size="14" class="qh-cnt">1,412
      <animate attributeName="opacity" from="1" to="0" begin="1.4s" dur="0.25s" fill="freeze"/>
    </text>
    <text x="535" y="317" text-anchor="middle" font-size="14" class="qh-cnt" opacity="0">1,413
      <animate attributeName="opacity" from="0" to="1" begin="1.4s" dur="0.25s" fill="freeze"/>
      <animate attributeName="opacity" from="1" to="0" begin="2.9s" dur="0.25s" fill="freeze"/>
    </text>
    <text x="535" y="317" text-anchor="middle" font-size="14" class="qh-cnt" opacity="0">1,416
      <animate attributeName="opacity" from="0" to="1" begin="2.9s" dur="0.25s" fill="freeze"/>
    </text>

    <!-- the lens at dead centre -->
    <circle cx="320" cy="180" r="3.5" fill="#e8dcc0">
      <animate attributeName="r" values="3;7;3" dur="5s" repeatCount="indefinite"/>
      <animate attributeName="opacity" values="1;0.5;1" dur="5s" repeatCount="indefinite"/>
    </circle>
  </g>

  <!-- castellation frame -->
  <rect x="0"   y="0"   width="640" height="20"  fill="url(#qh-castH)"/>
  <rect x="0"   y="340" width="640" height="20"  fill="url(#qh-castH)"/>
  <rect x="0"   y="20"  width="20"  height="320" fill="url(#qh-castV)"/>
  <rect x="620" y="20"  width="20"  height="320" fill="url(#qh-castV)"/>
  <rect x="18"  y="18"  width="604" height="324" fill="none" stroke="#d8c79a" stroke-width="1.5"/>

  <!-- sweeping scanline -->
  <rect x="18" width="604" height="3" fill="url(#qh-scan)" opacity="0.14">
    <animate attributeName="y" values="22;336;22" dur="7s" repeatCount="indefinite"/>
  </rect>

  <!-- vignette -->
  <rect x="0" y="0" width="640" height="360" fill="url(#qh-vig)" pointer-events="none"/>
</svg>
name: quiet_hour_testcard
